topicName: Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Tutorial: Integrating Security into the Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Modern software delivery requires speed, but moving fast cannot come at the expense of security. The Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) integrates security practices at every phase of development, while DevSecOps embeds security automation directly into the CI/CD pipeline. This tutorial covers the foundational principles and technical implementations needed to build a robust DevSecOps framework."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Phase 1: Threat Modeling in the Design Phase"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Before writing code, teams must identify potential threats using methodologies like STRIDE (Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information Disclosure, Denial of Service, Elevation of Privilege). Threat modeling helps architects visualize system components, data flows, and trust boundaries."},{"order":5,"type":"subheading","text":"Phase 2: Automated Security in the CI/CD Pipeline"},{"order":6,"type":"paragraph","text":"DevSecOps relies heavily on automation to catch vulnerabilities early. Security gates are placed at multiple stages of the pipeline: Static Application Security Testing (SAST) during code commit, Software Composition Analysis (SCA) for dependency checks, and Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) on staging environments."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Step-by-Step Implementation: GitHub Actions Workflow"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"Below is a sample GitHub Actions YAML configuration demonstrating how to integrate SAST (Semgrep) and SCA (Trivy) into your CI/CD pipeline."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"name: DevSecOps Pipeline
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Run Trivy Vulnerability Scanner
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: 'fs'
          format: 'table'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
      - name: Run Semgrep SAST
        uses: returntocorp/semgrep-action@v1
        with:
          config: 'p/security-audit'"},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices for Sustained Success"},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Shift Left: Introduce security requirements and testing as early as the planning and design phases."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Automate Everything: Ensure vulnerability scanning happens on every pull request to prevent regressions."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Continuous Monitoring: Track production environments for misconfigurations and newly discovered zero-day vulnerabilities."}]
